title: Earworms: Why Songs Get Stuck in Your Head
caption:
That song stuck in your head has a name: an earworm.
A cartoon guy sits down to study in peace, until glowing music notes swarm his head and a brain scan shows the tune trapped on repeat.
When your brain is idle, your auditory cortex gets stuck replaying a short neural loop - chew gum or solve an anagram to break it.
Which song is stuck in your head right now?
Save this for the next chorus invasion, and follow for more body science.
